about: ADR 0144 M0 stand-in owned by the confinement track (Bozniak), amended by ADR 0154 (one qrtz identity). Read by crates/qrtz-lifecycle/tests/offline_graph.rs. It maps today's code to the module that will own it. Bobs's module manifests replace the owner fields; the ratchet lists only shrink. appTccEntitlements is the single app's TCC entitlement allowlist: every entry carries an ADR note and changes only with one.

networkRoles.about: ADR 0231 amendment 1 (Bozniak): the one generic exception to the ADR 0078 offline checks. offline_graph.rs applies every offline check to every crate except one mapped here, and holds each mapped crate to its own rule instead: a separate process that no workspace crate links (normal edge), whose direct network crates are exactly netCrates, whose workspace dependencies are shared-owned only, whose sources name no URL outside egress, and which never ships in a release bundle (scripts/release/verify-bundle.sh). A new entry needs its own ADR and Bozniak's review.

bundledCode.about: ADR 0162, ADR 0169, ADR 0174: the executables Tauri bundles as externalBin into qrtz.app/Contents/MacOS (tauri.macos.conf.json): the `qrtz` command and, since ADR 0174, echo's own executable qrtz-echo (signed ai.qrtz.echo with its own entitlements; the app's notarization covers it, so it has no per-module notarization record). nano, ctrl and snap ship only in their packages (moduleCode). tauri build re-signs every externalBin with the app's entitlements and its file name as identifier, so scripts/release/sign-mac.sh signs each again as listed here (identifier, entitlements file or none) and reseals the app before notarization.

moduleCode.about: ADR 0169, ADR 0170: each downloadable module's executable (nano, ctrl, snap; echo is bundledCode since ADR 0174), shipped only in its own extension package (bin/qrtz-<id>, the package's extension.entry and module.json launch.entry), never in qrtz.app. scripts/modules/build-packages.sh signs each as listed (its identifier is the one the module's lock entry and module.json code pin, so the installer's and the launcher's designated-requirement checks pass) and scripts/modules/publish.sh notarizes it before it enters the index. inherits: runs as qrtz's child under qrtz's one TCC identity (ADR 0154).

devHelper.about: The monolith qrtz-helper (every module in one process) is a dev tool only now: QRTZ_HELPER_BIN in a debug build. scripts/dev/sign.sh signs it as ai.qrtz.helper; it never ships and no lock entry names it.
devHelper.name: qrtz-helper

appTccEntitlements.com.apple.security.device.audio-input: ADR 0154: the microphone, for echo dictation and nano recordings (held by qrtz.app since M4.7)
ADR 0217: Apple Calendar, read-only, for nano (EventKit in qrtz-nano; asked only when the user turns the calendar on in nano)
appTccEntitlements.com.apple.security.automation.apple-even: ADR 0154: Apple Events, held by qrtz.app only. ctrl's use is REVOKED (ADR 0214 security review, 2026-10-19): ctrl do never sends Apple Events and qrtz-ctrl's signature carries no entitlement; kept on the host until Bozniak rules on it

entitlements.naming: ai.qrtz.<extension>.entitlements for an extension helper (echo, nano, ctrl, snap; accepted, not required, ADR 0154); ai.qrtz.inference.<name>.entitlements for a sandboxed inference XPC service (e.g. ai.qrtz.inference.voice.entitlements)
entitlements.extensionHelpersAllowed: appTccEntitlements: an extension helper shares qrtz's identity and may hold only what the app may (ADR 0154)
